title: Polynomial-time computability of level bits
statement: Let $w$ assign a natural number to each finite Boolean string. If the function sending a string $x$ to the string of $w(x)$ true bits is computable in polynomial time, then the function sending $x$ to the concatenation of $w(x)$ copies of a block consisting of $w(x)$ true bits followed by $2w(x)$ false bits is computable in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: A function $w$ from finite Boolean strings to natural numbers
The function $x\mapsto$ a string of $w(x)$ true bits is polynomial-time computable
